title: Angle-domain null subtraction imaging from beamformed plane-wave data
matched_query: ultrafast ultrasound imaging angle-domain null subtraction beamforming 2026

reduces simulated -6 dB lateral width from 0.226 mm for DAS to 0.116 mm while retaining reconstruction time close to DAS

summary_en: Introduces angle-domain null subtraction imaging, a post-beamforming variant of NSI that applies zero-mean weighting across steering-angle images rather than receive elements. It improves apparent lateral resolution over DAS while keeping runtime close to conventional coherent plane-wave compounding and is validated in simulation, microbubble power-Doppler data, and in-vivo carotid imaging.
